failures: Export requires publish or HTTP result service, or triggers acquisition/parse
Workbook differs from exact 16-column contract, required/enumerated/date/text cell rules
Single file has volume order, continuous volumes miss 1..N, independent attachments lose individual titles
Names, bytes, size or SHA-256 differ between metadata, manifest, CAS and authorized API
Manifest lacks real lineage locator, frozen coverage, explicit sources or accurate counts
API pointer or SQL/CAS facts mutate during explicit Snapshot export
Snapshot A export mixes in B after collect/publish B
Repeated same-parameter exports differ byte-for-byte, or same destination is overwritten
Missing/corrupt CAS objects, unknown source, cancellation or capacity excess publish a final directory
Offline moved verify accesses SQL/S3, accepts corrupt/missing/unlisted payload or unsafe paths
Workbook formula injection executes or leading-zero official codes are changed
Unreliable volume sequence is guessed instead of refused
Package reveals absolute workspace paths or private storage credentials

fixture_boundaries.positive: Real seal init/collect/snapshot/export/publish/serve CLIs against isolated PostgreSQL and S3 with loopback HTTP HTML/DOCX fixture
fixture_boundaries.negative_storage: Deliberately corrupt/delete only objects in acceptance-owned bucket, restore after each case
fixture_boundaries.no_original: Requires a real CLI producer of body slices; only web adapter is documented for stage 1, so record explicitly if unavailable
fixture_boundaries.capacity: Exercise cell-capacity excess via oversized source title; do not seed implementation internals
fixture_boundaries.cancellation: Pause an acceptance-owned S3 read with an HTTP proxy and terminate export before completion
